newsitem.title: USA: Showscan sells up to 10 simulation theaters.
newsitem.headline: Showscan sells up to 10 simulation theaters.

text.p: Showscan Entertainment Inc Wednesday said it reached an agreement to sell five Showscan Simulation Attraction Theatres to Auscinemagic PTY Limited with an option to supply five more theaters.
In a statement, the company said the first theatre is scheduled to open before March 31, 1997, at Darling Harbour in Sydney, Australia.

The agreement calls for a minimum of five Showscan Simulation Attraction Theatres to be built in Australia and New Zealand before November 12, 1998, with an option to build five additional theatres. The transaction is valued at between $4 million and $8 million, depending on the number of theatres built and their individual configurations.
Showscan makes simulation and special-format theaters.
